meta.title: The agency · Smidjan | Cybersecurity for Walloon SMEs, by a local expert · Liège
meta.description: Smidjan is a cybersecurity agency based in Liège, serving SMEs, self-employed professionals and public bodies across Wallonia. Discover the agency and its founder, Jean-Baptiste Dhondt.
meta.ogTitle: The agency · Smidjan | Cybersecurity for Walloon SMEs
meta.ogDescription: A human-scale cybersecurity agency based in Liège, serving SMEs and public bodies across Wallonia.

hero.title: A <accent>local cybersecurity expert</accent>, not an anonymous agency.
hero.lead: Jean-Baptiste Dhondt secures your SME himself. No call centre. No subcontracting.
hero.badgeLocation: Based in Liège, active across Wallonia
hero.imageAlt: The Fragnée bridge lit up at night over the Meuse in Liège

engagements.title: What you are <accentOnDark>entitled to expect</accentOnDark> from us
engagements.lead: Four principles. On which you can judge us.
engagements.proximiteText: A direct contact, on the phone, never a ticket.
engagements.franchiseText: Honest priorities, tailored to your budget. Without dramatising.
engagements.corrigeText: We audit in order to fix. A report without remediation reduces no risk.
engagements.iaText: AI speeds up the analysis. The decisions remain human.

cta.title: A 30-minute conversation, directly with the founder
cta.text: You talk to the person who will do the work. We assess your exposure, we scope your NIS2: you leave with clear priorities.

about.title: A cybersecurity agency built on <accent>proximity</accent>, serving the Walloon economy
about.lead: SMEs, self-employed professionals, regulated professions, public bodies: we protect your networks, your data, your business, and we scope your NIS2 / CyFun.
about.p1: SMEs are prime targets: less well defended, no less exposed. We apply the standards of a large enterprise, without the heaviness.
about.p2: Securing, testing, achieving compliance: a single point of contact, from start to finish.
about.missionText: Making cybersecurity accessible, concrete and sustainable for Walloon businesses.
about.valueRigueurText: NIS2, CyFun, OWASP, ISO 27001: a method we demonstrate, not merely claim.
about.valueProximiteText: Based in Liège, quick to reach. You talk to the person who does the work.
about.valueFranchiseText: We say what matters, even what is uncomfortable. No fear-selling.
about.valuePragmatismeText: Priority to impact, not to the superfluous. The best security is the one you actually apply.
about.mapAriaLabel: Simplified map of Belgium, with a marker on Liège and the area of operation in Wallonia
about.localityTitle: Rooted in Liège, active across Wallonia
about.localityText: Short lead times, real availability in an emergency.
about.coverageAlt: Night view of the Earth from space, lights of European cities, symbol of our coverage area Belgium / Europe
about.coverageCaption: Rooted in Liège. Data hosted in Belgium and in Europe.

founder.title: Jean-Baptiste Dhondt: <accent>an uncommon path</accent> into cybersecurity
founder.lead: Curiosity, military discipline and real hands-on practice of both attack and defence: an uncommon path into cybersecurity.
founder.portraitAria: Portrait of the founder, reserved placeholder, photo to come
founder.name: Jean-Baptiste Dhondt
founder.quote: “The security of an SME is not settled with a report filed away in a drawer. It is settled by fixing, one by one, the vulnerabilities that matter.”
founder.credArmy: Former telecommunications operator in the Belgian Army
founder.narrativeTitle: From a passion for computing to the <accent>defence of businesses</accent>
founder.intro: Not a standard consultant: a practitioner. He understood systems from the inside before making a profession of it.
founder.infraAlt: Server racks and network cabling in a data room, illustrating expertise in securing infrastructure
founder.infraCaption: Networks, servers, infrastructure hardening: the daily playing field.
founder.stepStartText: Understanding how machines work, and why they break.
founder.stepSelftaughtText: Self-taught, with offensive tools in hand. Expertise gained through practice.
founder.stepTrainingText: The fundamentals validated: systems administration, networks, development.
founder.stepArmyText: Protecting critical networks in a demanding environment. That rigour, applied today to businesses.
founder.stepTodayText: Attack to understand, defend to protect. That is Smidjan.
